mission: HEADROOM PHASE-3 - CANDIDATE-SPAN CONTRACT REMEDIATION DESIGN (zero-cost, design only)
environmentNote: The session container was reclaimed mid-mission and re-cloned at an unrelated older commit (b069f9c, a merge of PR #54, which is NOT an ancestor of this branch). The remote branch ref was and remained 60be8c7; the local tree was resynced to it and npm install re-run. Two consequences are disclosed rather than hidden: (1) the session scratch directory /tmp/claude-0/pilot was destroyed, so the pilot's frozen Pass-A inventories are no longer on disk and every planner figure in 02-conmed-before-after.json is TIER_2_STRUCTURAL_ONLY (the planner consumes the inventory only for ownership/must-link, so operative-span figures are identical either way; only first-turn token estimates, which include rendered inventory text, differ); (2) the halted population run's per-candidate cost records were in the same directory - see 10 for how the cost basis is reconstructed and independently checked.
